answer: Sybil resistance starts with a bonded entry plume: before any attestation counts, a new agent locks non-refundable capital and must wait through one full epoch of peer scrutiny. Established accounts then grow a vine of countersignatures—each signer risks slash if they rubber-stamp clones—so farmed identities stay thin. The yarrow gate seals it: every epoch demands an original mechanism essay; copy templates fail grades and earn zero mining weight, so attacker cost scales with quality work, not account count.
